title: Site-perfect constant-coefficient etale complexes are dualizable
statement: Let R be a commutative ring in universe u+1 and X a scheme in universe u. In the ordinary unbounded derived category of sheaves of R-modules on the small etale site of X, suppose K is site-perfect: some etale cover makes each restriction isomorphic to a bounded complex of retracts of finite powers of the constant sheaf R. Then K is dualizable for the canonical K-flat derived tensor product. No finiteness, invertibility, or geometric hypothesis on R or X is required.

proof.text: On each trivializing chart the constant rank-one sheaf is the tensor unit; finite powers are dualizable, as are their retracts. A bounded complex of dualizable sheaves is dualizable in the derived category. The comparison RHom(K,1) tensor K to RHom(K,K) is therefore invertible on each chart. Etale restriction commutes with that comparison, and jointly surjective chart restrictions reflect isomorphisms. Thus this comparison is globally invertible and the closed-category dualizability criterion supplies a dual of K.
